sources.cite: Prescott HC, et al. Surviving Sepsis Campaign: International Guidelines for Management of Sepsis and Septic Shock 2026. Crit Care Med 2026;54(4)
sources.note: Relayed from the NCLEX-RN case med-surg-deterioration-sbar, not re-read for this band; its note: As relayed by secondary summaries (read for the CCRN sepsis case 2026-11-10, not re-read): antimicrobials immediately, ideally within 1 h, in possible septic shock; cultures first only without delaying the dose; crystalloid first line; lactate measured.
